title: RegionBarrier
description: Packet-based barrier walls that appear around WorldGuard regions for non-donors. Fully client-side, can't be broken, and won't affect server performance. Just set a region prefix and players without the bypass permission see glass walls.
body:
## RegionBarrier

  Display fake glass walls around WorldGuard regions using packets. Perfect for donor/VIP areas - players see barriers but can't break them since they're client-side only.

  Features

  - 🔮 Packet-based barriers (no real blocks placed)
  - 🚫 Unbreakable - clients can't remove them
  - ⚡ Only renders near players for performance
  - 🔷 Supports polygonal and cuboid regions
  - 🎨 Configurable block type and distance

  Requirements

  - WorldGuard plugin
  (https://dev.bukkit.org/projects/worldguard)
  - PacketEvents plugin
  (https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents)

  Showcase
  - https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1277201140622299169/1456433247855710330/2.gif?ex=695858a9&is=69570729&hm=93ab2ca5784f3b1a921cd684317f0bdafb05028b1eba451509f97af4c9ed00b8&

  Supported Platforms

  - Paper/Spigot (1.21+)

  Create a WorldGuard region with prefix donator_ and players without bypass see glass walls!

  Any issues, please contact me on discord: w1fl0w
